**`filter.renderer.addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — ≈28 inbound call edges (from 14 distinct caller methods)**

It's the top function/method by fan-in among all symbols declared under `internal/` (the only `internal/` symbols above it in the graph are types, not callables: `profile.Profile` in=32 at `internal/profile/profile.go:15`, `filter.renderResult` in=29, `filter.Condition` in=28).

Why it's the hub: `addArg` is the single argument-binding sink of the SQL renderer, so every predicate-rendering path funnels through it — `internal/filter/render.go`: `renderScalarComparison:304`, `renderAccessorComparison:200`, `renderFunctionComparison:249`, `renderJSONBoolComparison:357`, `renderTagEquals:711`, `renderTagInList:434`, `renderTagStartsWith:727`, `renderElementInCondition:483`, `renderScalarInCondition:516`, `renderRegex:558`, `foldedLike:578`, `elementPredicateSQL:695`, `buildJSONArrayLike:770`, plus the thin wrapper `addBoolArg:851`.

Runners-up among callables: `filter.Schema.Field` — `internal/filter/schema.go:67` (in=19), and `renderer.MarkdownRenderer.renderChildren` — `internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:170` (in=14).
